Agent Name: Eateries_Expert
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Eateries_Expert made a critical error in Step 1 by providing a misleading summary of the search results ("None of the eateries identified near Harkness Memorial State Park meet the requirement..."). This summary was factually incorrect because the subsequent search results (provided by the Computer_terminal) clearly listed eateries like "Ballo Italian Kitchen & Bar" and "Captain Scott's Lobster Dock" which are located near the park. By prematurely concluding that no eateries met the criteria based on an incomplete or hallucinated initial scan, the agent prevented the team from verifying the hours of the actual eateries found in the search results. This premature conclusion led to the incorrect final answer (McDonald's) instead of identifying the correct eatery (Ballo Italian Kitchen & Bar) that was open until 11 PM.
